about_the_game:
Embark on a captivating journey of planetary evolution with Earth Clicker. This idle clicker game invites you to shape and nurture your own virtual Earth, guiding it from the dawn of life to a thriving ecosystem.

Key Features:

  • Interactive Planetary Development: Begin with a newly created planet Earth and cultivate life through strategic clicks and upgrades.

  • Diverse Life Forms: Introduce and manage various species, including humans and animals, to create a balanced and dynamic ecosystem.

  • Comprehensive Upgrade System: Enhance your planet's growth by investing in technological advancements, educational systems, and biodiversity initiatives.

  • Real-Time Progression: Experience the passage of time with a dynamic day-night cycle and track your planet's development through detailed statistics.

  • Immersive Visuals: Enjoy a visually engaging experience with advanced 3D graphics, allowing for zoom and exploration of your evolving world.

Whether you're a fan of idle games or seeking a relaxing yet engaging simulation, Earth Clicker offers a unique experience in planetary management. Shape the destiny of your world, one click at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 or AMD RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or DirectX 9 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Embark on a journey of planetary evolution in Earth Clicker. Begin with a barren world and cultivate life through strategic clicks and upgrades. Manage diverse species, enhance ecosystems, and witness your planet's transformation in real-time. Shape the destiny of your world, one click at a time.
